title: The run-epic in-run gate skips the end-to-end classification and routing tests
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out (94172602): the in-run go gate runs -short, which skips every end-to-end classification and mass-routing test, so a regression there passes every tick's gate.
acceptance_criteria: The classification and routing end-to-end tests run somewhere that gates (CI or an admitted slot in the per-tick gate), with the choice recorded
